spec.studio_prompt: A freestanding solid oak rectangular dining table measuring 180 cm long, 90 cm wide, and 75 cm high. Constructed from premium European oak with a rich warm natural oak hue #81684b, deep golden grain accents #4b3421, and soft honey undertones #a29680. The design features a smooth flat rectangular top seamlessly meeting four thick, square block legs positioned flush at each outer corner. A subtle straight perimeter apron connects beneath the tabletop edges. The wood surface displays an authentic, fine linear grain with a soft matte oiled finish, exhibiting crisp geometric lines and immaculate joinery throughout.
